name: supinated narrow grip pull up
description: Chin-up style pull-up with a close underhand grip that puts extra work on the biceps along with the lats.
instructions: Grip the bar with palms facing you, hands close together.
Hang with arms straight and shoulders pulled down.
Pull your elbows down and in until your chin is above the bar.
Lower under control to full arm extension.
Keep your legs still and avoid swinging.
